_comment: Copy to config.json, badlo, phir: rough_cut.py take.mp4 --config config.json
_silence_db: Isse dheemi awaaz = silence. Shor wale kamre me -34, shaant kamre me -42.
_silence_min: Itni der chup raho tabhi silence maana jayega (seconds).
_pre_pad: Har bole hue tukde se itna pehle se cut shuru. Kam karoge to pehla akshar katega.
_post_pad: Tukde ke baad itna rakho. Hinglish me aakhri shabd thoda lamba khinchta hai.
_max_pause: Isse lamba pause chhota kar diya jayega.
_pause_keep: Lambe pause ki jagah itna rakho. 0.2 se neeche mat jao - robot lagega.
_scene_lead_in: Video ke bilkul shuru me itni extra jagah.
_scene_tail: Video ke ant me itni extra jagah, taaki CTA ruke.
_min_piece: Isse chhota tukda bolna nahi, saans ya khat-pat hai - hata do.
